title: E2E test: Migration confirmation modal flow
description: Playwright end-to-end test verifying the post-login migration confirmation modal works correctly for accept, decline, and Settings recovery paths.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test: Anonymous user practices, gains progress in localStorage
Test: User signs up, verifies magic link
Test: Migration modal appears after login
Test: ACCEPT path - data migrates, localStorage cleared
Test: DECLINE path - userId added to declined array, localStorage kept
Test: Declined user doesn't see modal on re-login
Test: Different user on same device DOES see modal
Test: Settings import option appears for declined users
Test: Settings import successfully recovers data
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'migration-confirm'

technicalNotes: May need test bypass for magic link or use tempmail integration
Test serial execution for stateful tests
testingNotes: Consider test timeouts for email verification steps
Clean up test users after tests
